morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。IPA 为英语名称的读法，不能据此认定已有统一的马来语标准读音；未核实马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 阿卡迪亚：希腊伯罗奔尼撒半岛中部的历史地理区域。
senses.en_definition: Arcadia, a historical region in the central Peloponnese of Greece.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi sebuah wilayah bersejarah di bahagian tengah Peloponnese, Yunani.
senses.nuances: 作为地名须写 Arcadia。输入包没有 DBP 定义；这里的马来文是编写释义，并非 DBP 原文。status 按指定格式保留为 official，仅作本条记录标签，不表示已核实 DBP 收录或认可。[Oxford Classical Dictionary：Arcadia](https://doi.org/10.1093/acrefore/9780199381135.013.659)

senses.zh_definition: 文学中象征宁静、淳朴并与自然和谐相处的理想田园世界。
senses.en_definition: An idealized pastoral world of rural peace, simplicity, and harmony with nature.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam tradisi sastera Barat, alam desa ideal yang melambangkan kedamaian, kesederhanaan dan keharmonian dengan alam.
senses.nuances: 这是西方文学典故义，不宜视作马来语日常常用名词。下列搭配是文学讨论中的自然表达，未经马来语语料频率验证；马来文释义为编写释义。[Collins：Arcadia](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/arcadia)

dual_scenarios.context: 文学评论 / 学术汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam analisis ini, Arcadia melambangkan kehidupan desa yang damai dan harmoni dengan alam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这项分析中，阿卡迪亚象征宁静且与自然和谐共处的乡村生活。
dual_scenarios.en: In this analysis, Arcadia symbolizes peaceful rural life in harmony with nature.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论文学读物
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Arcadia dalam buku ni tempat betul ke, atau tempat rekaan je?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Arcadia dalam buku ini tempat sebenar atau sekadar tempat rekaan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这本书里的阿卡迪亚是真地方，还是虚构的啊？
dual_scenarios.en: Is Arcadia in this book a real place, or is it just made up?

messages.en: There is a real Arcadia in Greece, but in literature the name also stands for peaceful country life.

etymology.historical_story: Arcadia began as the name of a mountainous Greek region. Literary tradition transformed the geographical name into an image of peaceful pastoral life, far removed from ordinary conflict. Its later figurative meaning describes an ideal rural world rather than the historical region itself. This is a European literary association, not an inherited Malay word history. [Collins: Arcadia](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/arcadia)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 Arcadia，脑中放一幅“阿卡迪亚山间牧歌图”：真地名引出理想田园的文学意象。
